report.note: RESEARCH ONLY. No production code, projection, calibration coefficient, threshold, bankroll, or fee logic was changed to produce this report. See data/edgelab/reports/retrospective_validation_audit.md for full narrative.

keyQuestionAnswers.1_modelCalibratedOverallAndByFamily: Partial. 40-60% probability range is well-calibrated; 60-70% bucket (n=48) is materially overconfident. Only inning_result/F5 beats market Brier at real sample size.
keyQuestionAnswers.2_higherEdgeBetterPerformance: Yes for the extremes (edge<0% vs edge>=10%), sign-consistent across DEV/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT. Middle of distribution too sparse to judge.
keyQuestionAnswers.3_netExecutableEdgeVsGross: No separate net-edge field on placed bets; fee-aware backtest is the correct source. Fees consume ~3.3-3.8pp of ROI consistently; edge-bucket sign survives fee-adjustment in all 3 partitions.
keyQuestionAnswers.4_repeatableMarketFamilyBias: inning_result/F5 repeatable positive; game_result/full-game-ML repeatable negative and dominated by F5; team_total miscalibrated at real n; game_total/pitcher-props/hitter-props unmeasurable (no model coverage).
keyQuestionAnswers.5_lineupConfirmationImpact: Yes, materially (~38pp ROI gap CONFIRMED vs UNKNOWN), consistent across two independent groupings, but n=20 is DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY not yet CALIBRATED.
keyQuestionAnswers.6_pitcherPropWorkloadWeakness: Cannot answer as posed - zero model coverage on pitcher_strikeouts/pitcher_outs. This is a coverage gap, not evidence of a weak signal.
keyQuestionAnswers.7_hitterPromotionJustified: No. Zero model coverage across all 5 hitter families at every threshold. Remain RESEARCH_ONLY.
keyQuestionAnswers.8_clvSupportsEdgeClaim: Inconclusive - only 20/117 decided bets have a real (non-UNKNOWN) CLV bucket. Data-capture gap, not a finding about CLV itself.
keyQuestionAnswers.9_bestExpressionCouldImproveReturns: Structurally plausible (F5 dominates full-game ML in every dominated case found) but empirically thin: 2/7 audited placed bets dominated, 0.0% simulated ROI delta at n=117.
keyQuestionAnswers.10_sampleSizeJustifiesRetuning: No. Framework's own maturity gate reads FRAMEWORK_ONLY_INSUFFICIENT_DATES (20 of a documented 30+ date target). No dimension in this audit clears that bar.

measurementNotesNotFixed: 2026-08-11 through 2026-08-15: complete gap in EVALUATED ModelEvaluation records (0.0% coverage across ~17,500+ raw rows). Not root-caused in this PR; does not bias measurement of surrounding dates.
Daily/weekly/monthly trend tables dominated by a 'None' period (n=103) because most placed bets lack a resolved entryTimestamp bucket.
report.recommendation: DO_NOT_CHANGE projection/calibration/threshold/bankroll/fee logic. Strongest candidate for future promotion (once dates >= 30): edge>=10% vs edge<0% bucket split.
